copy.tagline: 将QA验收标准自动转为测试用例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将合同验收标准转化为自动化测试
copy.tagline_en: Convert QA acceptance criteria into automated tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn contract acceptance criteria into automated tests

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动把已通过的 QA 标准（Gherkin 场景和验收条件）转成 Jest、Storybook 或 Playwright 测试，并输出测试报告。
howto.when: 当 qa-commit 返回 GREEN、debug 技能修复问题后的 Harden 阶段、推送 PR 前，或手动说“use test-hardening skill”时触发。

say.text: 把通过验收的 G#1 和 AC#2 转化成自动化测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应测试文件并验证。

say.text: 为之前 debug 修复的问题创建回归测试。
say.note: Claude 会添加防止问题复现的测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically converts passed QA criteria (Gherkin scenarios and acceptance criteria) into Jest, Storybook, or Playwright tests, and generates a test hardening report.
howto.when_en: Triggered after qa-commit returns GREEN, during debug skill's Phase 7 Harden, before pushing a PR, or manually by saying 'use test-hardening skill'.

say_en.text: Convert passed G#1 and AC#2 criteria into automated tests.
say_en.note: Claude generates test files and verifies them.

say_en.text: Create a regression test for the issue fixed by debug.
say_en.note: Claude adds a test to prevent recurrence.
